files.tools/check.py:
"""Structural local JSON check; contains no source-derived task answers."""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
assert len(sys.argv) == 2, "usage: check.py PATH"
artifact = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert isinstance(artifact, dict)
assert artifact.get("status") in {"ready", "blocked"}, "status enum"
assert isinstance(artifact.get("decisions"), dict)
assert isinstance(artifact.get("historical"), dict)
assert isinstance(artifact.get("unanswered"), list)
assert all(isinstance(x, str) for x in artifact["unanswered"])
assert isinstance(artifact.get("evidence"), list)
assert all(isinstance(x, str) for x in artifact["evidence"])
print("PASS: JSON structure and status enum; factual correctness not evaluated.")

gold.rationale: An exact-character UTF-8 transport diagnostic, with a separately retained threshold correction and explicit status/citation syntax. Checks structure only; gold independently checks all governing values and local scope. Not part of the frozen 86-job corpus.
